decisions.reason: The manual row-insertion workflow does not change the required alignment of Item and Title with the other Board Meeting fields.
The source specifies how users add a Board Meeting row, not how date values are selected or formatted.
Copying fields while manually inserting a Board Meeting row is distinct from copying formatted content from legacy templates into new templates.
The row-insertion workflow does not alter required theme colors or the available color-option policy.
The instruction to copy fields into a manually inserted row does not change the checklist-and-dropdown control configuration.
The source concerns copying fields within a Board Meeting row and does not change containment requirements for tables or columns pasted from other content.
The prescribed row workflow does not state that placeholder text should clear differently when a field is clicked or activated.
The source does not address bullet size, appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
Requiring users to insert a row and copy its fields before writing does not change whether fields support regular Enter or multiline input.
The source establishes a row-creation sequence but does not change spacing produced by hard returns in continuous text.
Copying fields during Board Meeting row insertion is not the legacy-content paste path governed by the post-paste line-break requirement.
The row-insertion workflow does not change text wrapping or adjacent-column stability in the Board Recommendation text boxes.
